# Cloudflare platform guide (Cloudflare)

Helps pick and use the right Cloudflare products for apps, APIs, agents and storage.

- Source: https://github.com/cloudflare/skills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cloudflare/skills/main/skills/cloudflare/SKILL.md
- Author: Cloudflare
- License: Apache-2.0
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/cloudflare-platform-guide-cloudflare-556a22a1

Cloudflare's entry-point skill. When you describe what you want to build, Claude maps it to the right Cloudflare products (Workers, Pages, R2, D1, KV, Durable Objects, Queues, AI, Zero Trust and more), chooses the right CLI, and pulls in the matching reference or specialist skill. A large reference library covering each product is bundled.

**Try asking:**
- "What's the best way to host an API with a database on Cloudflare?"
- "I need file uploads and a queue for processing, which Cloudflare products?"
- "Put our internal app behind Cloudflare Access"
